June 5, 2018 - By Winifred Garcia
Zevin Asset Management Llc decreased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 4.72% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Zevin Asset Management Llc sold 1,954 shares as the company’s stock rose 5.37% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 39,448 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $6.62M, down from 41,402 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Zevin Asset Management Llc who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $949.04 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.65% or $1.2548 $193.0848. About 13.17M shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 22.56% uptrending. It has outperformed by 9.99% the S&P500.
